human_approval.notes: No human approval is claimed. All nine of NSC-054's completion gates are automated Play Mode assertions and none contains a human review clause. THIS RECORD EXISTS TO CORRECT A MISBINDING: the prior record DEL-NSC-054-633cc78be73f binds validated_state.commit 633cc78be73fba6d17949665c6c30b00702dd8bd, which is NOT an ancestor of main - verified with git merge-base --is-ancestor, which returns non-zero. Its sibling 60d874f2 carries identical content and is on main. All three owned source files are byte-identical between 633cc78b and this commit, so the code never changed; the task read needs_testing with finding evidence_stale because later tracked changes moved HEAD. This record re-binds the same evidence to a main-reachable commit and re-runs the fixture there rather than asserting the old run still applies. Hand authored rather than via generate_delivery_spec finalize because that tool's non-required path demands a pipeline validation event id and this Unity run was performed by hand; citing one the pipeline never issued would overstate the evidence. Recorded by the Game Agent on 2026-09-25.
